info.title: Fraser Direct Universal API
info.description: Fraser Direct warehouse management and fulfillment API for orders, shipment lookups, inventory, purchase orders, and inventory adjustments.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

orderNumber.description: Order number. OrderNumber or PO must be provided.

po.description: Purchase order number. OrderNumber or PO must be provided.

poDate.description: Required order date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Optional requested delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

warehouseInstructions.description: Optional warehouse instructions. Fraser Direct's field name is spelled WarehouseIntructions in the API docs.

carrier.description: Optional carrier. If omitted, Fraser Direct rate shops based on ServiceLevel.

serviceLevel.description: Required service level. Valid values are STANDARD or EXPRESS.

poDate.description: Required purchase order date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vendorNumber.description: Required vendor number validated against Fraser Direct ERP.

depositorOrderNumber.description: DepositorOrderNumber or ShipmentIdentificationNumber must be provided.

shipmentIdentificationNumber.description: DepositorOrderNumber or ShipmentIdentificationNumber must be provided.

priority.description: Optional priority. Valid values are RUSH or empty.

detailList[].description: Required array of purchase-order line objects. Each line should include LineNumber, QuantityShipped, optional UOM, required SKU, and optional VendorLineNumber.
